speaker: Doctor
text: The normal echocardiogram rules out heart failure as the primary cause of your shortness of breath. Given your significant smoking history and the obstructive pattern on spirometry, do you experience worsening breathlessness when lying flat or while climbing stairs?

speaker: Doctor
text: The worsening dyspnea when lying flat (orthopnea) is a concerning symptom that can sometimes indicate cor pulmonale or severe COPD exacerbation, even with a normal echocardiogram.
